name: Custom Adam Implementation
aliases: Custom Adam Implementation — Fused Custom Adam, Optimized PyTorch Adam
definition: A custom Adam optimizer implementation that precisely matches PyTorch's behavior while optimizing away unnecessary overhead, exploiting CUDA kernel fusion, fast math operations, and fused-multiply additions.
summary: Custom Adam Implementation is a fused CUDA optimizer that eliminates CPU-GPU synchronization overhead and reduces instruction count via fast math, offering a drop-in replacement with lower memory footprint for volume rendering pipelines.
